remarksWeb: Promoters includes 3.65% as GDRs. Refer the Deposit Agreement between the Parties. Public includes 2.45% as GDRs. Refer the Deposit Agreement between the Parties. The Company has been informed that Trapti Trading & Investments Private Limited, Turquoise Investments and Finance Private Limited and TGS Investment & Trade Private Limited (erstwhile Promoter Group Companies and subsidiaries of Birla Group Holdings Private Limited ), have been amalgamated with Birla Group Holdings Private Limited with effect from 8th July 2019 vide NCLT Order dated 9th May 2019. Consequently, Trapti Trading & Investments Private Limited, Turquoise Investments and Finance Private Limited and TGS Investment & Trade Private Limited have ceased to exist with effect from 8th July 2019 and the shares held by Birla Group Holdings Private Limited has increased from 54,77,270 equity shares  (0.83%) to 12,50,04,398 equity shares  (19.01%). The said changes are also reflected in the details of Significant Beneficial Owner and the details of registered owner in this shareholding pattern. In terms of SEBI (Share Based Employee Benefits) Regulations, 2014, the trustees of the Grasim Employees� Welfare Trust (Trust) do not have voting rights in respect of the shares held by the Trust. The voting rights will be available to the individuals (Option Grantees) upon exercise of the Options by them under the Company's Employee Stock Option Scheme 2018.

name: Grasim Industries Limited
remarksWeb: Promoters includes 3.65% as GDRs. Refer the Deposit Agreement between the Parties.  Public includes 2.79% as GDRs. Refer the Deposit Agreement between the Parties.    Grasim Employees Welfare Trust (Trust) had acquired 59,559 Equity Shares of Grasim Industries Limited being 0.01% of the total paid up Equity Share Capital of Grasim Industries Limited from the secondary market on 28th March 2019. The said shares were credited in the Trust account post 31st March 2019.    Further, in terms of SEBI (Share Based Employee Benefits) Regulations, 2014, the trustees of the Trust do not have voting rights in respect of the shares held by the Trust. The voting rights will be available to the indivduals (Option Grantees) upon exercise of the Options by them under the Company's Employee Stock Option Scheme 2018.

name: Grasim Industries Limited
remarksWeb: The Company has received disclosure under Regulation 7(2) of SEBI (Prohibition of Insider Trading) Regulations, 2015 dated 1st October 2018 from one of the Promoter Group Companies viz. Manav Investment & Trading Company Limited regarding sale of their entire shareholding of 11,98,547 Equity Shares in the Company, on 28th September, 2018. The Company has also received another disclosure under Regulation 7(2) of SEBI (Prohibition of Insider Trading) Regulations, 2015 dated 3rd October 2018 from one of the Promoter Group Companies viz. Pilani Investment & Industries Corporation Limited ("Pilani") regarding their purchase of 11,98,547 Equity Shares of the Company on 28th September, 2018. As the above sale-purchase took place on 28th September, 2018, the said 11,98,547 equity shares sold by Manav are reflecting under the category "clearing members", as on 30th September, 2018. Based on the disclosures received from Manav and Pilani, the aforesaid 11,98,547 shares are shown as shares held by Pilani and the same have been reduced from the holding of Clearing Members, in the Shareholding Pattern of the Company, as on 30th September, 2018. Please note that as on 30th September, 2018 Manav holds Nil Equity Shares of the Company. Please also note that there is no change in the overall total promoter & promoter group shareholding in the Company as on 30th September, 2018 vis a vis June 30, 2018.
